privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.local: Your tasks and what Dhakerni learns about you stay on this device.
privacy.server: For reminders when the app is closed, our server keeps only: your push address, an anonymous ID, the time each reminder fires, and a short title (cut to 80 characters). All of it is encrypted, each reminder is deleted once you answer it or after its last repeat, and turning notifications off deletes the rest.

prayer.title: Prayer times
prayer.help: Choose your city so words like Asr or Maghrib become real times. Times are calculated on this device. Your city is never detected or sent anywhere.

reset.title: Reset
reset.confirm: Delete all tasks, everything Dhakerni has learned and all settings on this device, and turn off notifications? This can't be undone.

drag.cancelled: Move cancelled. {title} is back at position {pos}.

task.doneKeep: Finished tasks are removed after a day.

notify.testBody: This is how a reminder looks.

push.title: Notifications

status.enabled: On. Reminders arrive even when the app is closed.
status.default: Off. Reminders only show while the app is open.
status.denied: Blocked in your browser. Allow notifications for this site in the browser's site settings, then try again.
status.unsupported: This browser can't receive background reminders. They show while the app is open.
status.serverOff: Background reminders aren't set up on this server. They show while the app is open.
status.iosInstall: On iPhone and iPad, reminders need the app on your Home Screen.

push.testSent: Test sent. A second one comes through the server in about a minute: lock your phone now and wait for it.

ios.title: Add Dhakerni to your Home Screen
ios.step1: Tap the Share button in Safari.
ios.step3: Open Dhakerni from the Home Screen, then turn on notifications here.

push.banner: Get reminders even when the app is closed.
push.firefox: Desktop Firefox shows no buttons on notifications. Click the notification to open the app, then use Done or Snooze there.
push.repeats: A reminder you don't answer is sent again twice, 3 minutes apart, until you tap Done or Snooze.
push.android: Not getting reminders while the phone is locked? In Android Settings open Apps, Chrome, Battery and choose Unrestricted.
push.testLocalOnly: Test shown, but the server did not take the second one. Background reminders may not be working.
push.stalled: Background reminders are not being sent right now: nothing is triggering the server. Until that is fixed, reminders only show while the app is open.

memory.title: What Dhakerni knows about you
memory.intro: Everything learned stays on this device. Edit or delete any of it. Each request to the AI carries only the few facts that matter for that sentence.

learning.title: Keep learning
learning.on: Dhakerni learns from your answers and habits.
learning.off: Learning is off. Nothing new is saved. What is listed below is still used until you delete it.

memory.empty: Nothing learned yet. Answer a question or keep using Dhakerni and it will show up here.
memory.notYet: Not used yet. It starts once it repeats.
memory.forgetConfirm: Delete everything Dhakerni has learned about you? Your tasks stay.

backup.title: Backup
backup.body: Save your tasks and everything learned in one file, or restore from one.
backup.mergeHelp: Keeps your current data. The newer copy of anything in both wins.
backup.replaceHelp: This device becomes exactly the backup.

errors.too_new: This backup comes from a newer version of Dhakerni.

status.on: On. Reminders ring from this phone itself, even with the app closed, the phone asleep or no internet.
status.denied: Blocked. Allow notifications for Dhakerni in Android Settings, Apps, Dhakerni, Notifications.

native.testSent: A test reminder rings in 20 seconds. Lock your phone now.
native.exactOff: Android is not letting Dhakerni ring at the exact time, so reminders can be several minutes late.
native.battery: If a reminder ever comes late: in Android Settings, Apps, Dhakerni, Battery, choose Unrestricted. Some phones (Xiaomi, Oppo, Huawei) also need Autostart allowed.

get.title: Android app
get.body: Reminders that ring on time with the phone asleep, with no server in between. It updates itself: install it once.
